gloss: to be heard, to be audible

definitions.gloss: to be heard, to be audible
definitions.explanation: For a sound to reach one's ears and be perceivable. The intransitive/potential form of hearing.
To give the impression of a certain quality when heard.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}の{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえる。
それは{言|い}い{訳|わけ}に{聞|き}こえる。
{隣|となり}の{部屋|へや}から{音楽|おんがく}が{聞|き}こえてきた。
examples.english: Music could be heard coming from the next room.
examples.notes: {聞|き}こえてくる = come to be heard

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は{冗談|じょうだん}に{聞|き}こえたが、{本気|ほんき}だった。
examples.english: His story sounded like a joke, but he was serious.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}の{声|こえ}が{小|ちい}さくてよく{聞|き}こえなかった。
examples.english: The voice on the phone was quiet and I couldn't hear it well.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くから{太鼓|たいこ}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえてきて、お{祭|まつ}りが{始|はじ}まったのだと{分|わ}かった。
examples.english: I heard the sound of drums from far away and knew the festival had started.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). This is the spontaneous/potential form related to {聞|き}く (to hear/listen). Pattern: Xが{聞|き}こえる (X can be heard).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {聞|き}こえている = 'can be heard' (continuous).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえる (a voice can be heard)
・{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる (a sound can be heard)
・よく{聞|き}こえない (can't hear well)
・{聞|き}こえてくる (come to be heard, start hearing)
・〜に{聞|き}こえる (sound like ~)

CONTRAST:
・{聞|き}く: active listening/asking (transitive)
・{聞|き}こえる: passive hearing, audibility (intransitive)

RELATED PAIR: {見|み}る → {見|み}える (see → be visible) follows the same pattern.
